Paragraph: Some yogis perfectly worship the demigods by offering different sacrifices to them, and some of them offer sacrifices in the fire of the Supreme Brahman.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Understanding the diversity of human spiritual expressions, methods of sacrifice, and levels of motivation.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna states: 'Some yogis perfectly worship the demigods by offering different sacrifices to them, and some of them offer sacrifices in the fire of the Supreme Brahman.'
Outcome/Resolution: Validates various levels of human commitment while distinguishing between material worship, impersonal sacrifice, and total devotion.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Acceptance of Diversity: Recognizing that individuals approach personal growth through different stages
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Hierarchies of Motivation: Distinguishing between short-term material gain and ultimate self-realization
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Intentional Dedication: Directing internal efforts toward a specific object of focus

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Daivam evapare yajnam (Sacrifices offered to demigods for material gains)
Brahmagnav apare yajnam (Sacrifices offered into the fire of the Supreme Ultimate)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Sacrifices vary according to spiritual development, ranging from material ritualism to total self-offering in the Absolute.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: People seek fulfillment based on their current stage of awareness; recognizing these levels helps build empathy for diverse human choices.
